title: Smart Buildings: AI-Powered Efficiency and Sustainability
description: AI is used in smart buildings for energy management, maintenance, sensors, comfort systems, and infrastructure decisions that still need oversight.
short_description: A grounded guide to energy management, sensors, maintenance, occupant comfort, and the building systems that still need human oversight.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in smart buildings for developers, site managers, architects, and readers tracking the built environment.
